positions.as_written: Repeat with the knee flexed to about thirty degrees, since the patella engages the trochlea there and the glide should reduce.
Compare both knees, because the normal range of glide varies widely and only the comparison is interpretable.
Say that you would test at thirty degrees as well, and say why: the patella should engage the trochlea and the glide should fall.
